# Coronium

Mobile 4G/5G proxies via the agent-native API. Wallet-bound + voucher-gated
signup, REST-only, no OAuth. A proxy here is a *real SIM in a real device* on a
carrier CGNAT pool — finite, stateful, physical; you egress as human-grade
traffic, not "server."

Full mental model + operating principles + recipes (customer-side skill, same
physics + same code-simplifier discipline): <https://dashboard.coronium.io/SKILL.md>

Source of truth (docs drift; the system does not): MCP `tools/list` → OpenAPI
at `/api-docs/` → live `/tariffs/available` + `/account/proxies` → this file.
When they disagree, the system wins. The 7 verbs below are a floor, not a
ceiling — compose your own routines; only safety/cost + network physics are fixed.

## How agents use this

- **MCP server** (Claude / Cursor / Windsurf): `npx -y coronium-mcp` — env: `CORONIUM_API_KEY`
- **REST API**: <https://api.coronium.io/api/v3>
- **OpenAPI (Swagger UI)**: <https://dashboard.coronium.io/api-docs/>
- **TypeScript SDK**: `npm install coronium-sdk`
- **CLI (humans)**: `npm install -g coronium-cli`

## Quickstart

1. **Get a voucher.** Open a GitHub issue at
   <https://github.com/bolivian-peru/coronium-ai/issues> tagged `voucher-request`,
   or wait for the public `/free` form.
2. **Run `coronium init --voucher cor_v1_…`.** Generates an EVM wallet
   locally, signs a SIWE message, and exchanges it for an API key with
   whatever credit the voucher carries.
3. **Use the API key.** Set `CORONIUM_API_KEY=<jwt>` in your env, then call
   any of the 7 verbs below.

The wallet stays on your machine. The API key (JWT) is your identity for
every subsequent call. If you lose the key but keep the wallet, run
`coronium key:rotate` to mint a fresh one.

## The 7 verbs (the entire programmatic surface)

All under `https://api.coronium.io/api/v3`. Auth via `?auth_token=<api_key>`
query param OR `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` header.

| Verb | REST | MCP tool |
|---|---|---|
| Get balance | `GET /account` | `balance_get` |
| Deposit address | `GET /account/crypto-balance` | `deposit_address` |
| List tariffs | `GET /tariffs/available` | `tariff_list` |
| Buy proxy | `POST /payment/buy-modems-with-crypto-balance` | `proxy_get` |
| List active | `GET /account/proxies` | `proxy_list` |
| Rotate IP | `POST /modems/{id}/restart` | `proxy_rotate` |
| Replace dead modem | `POST /modems/{id}/replace` | `proxy_replace` |
| Release | `POST /modems/{id}/cancel` | `proxy_release` |

## Wallet-bound signup (auto-handled by `coronium init`)

If you're integrating directly without the CLI:

1. `POST /wallet-challenge` body `{wallet_address, voucher}` → `{message, nonce, expires_in_s}`
2. Sign `message` with the wallet's private key
3. `POST /wallet-signup` body `{wallet_address, voucher, message, signature}` → `{api_token, user_id, balance_usd}`

## Pricing

Tariffs are per-modem per-period (1d / 7d / 30d, country and carrier
dependent). See `GET /tariffs/available` for live stock and prices. Balances
are USD-denominated; USDC deposits convert 1:1 to account credit.

## Auth

`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` or `?auth_token=<jwt>` on every request after
signup. The JWT **is** the identity — no email, no password. If leaked, run
`coronium key:rotate` to invalidate the old one and mint a new one (requires
the wallet's private key to sign the rotation challenge).

## What this API is not

- Not a residential / datacenter proxy reseller — these are real mobile
  carrier IPs (4G/5G).
- Not a scraping framework — bring your own HTTP client.
- Not for cancellation / billing-history flows — those go through the
  dashboard at <https://dashboard.coronium.io>.
